title: Build separate admin authentication system with username/password login

requirements.summary: Create AdminLogin.tsx page component with username/password authentication form
acceptanceCriteria: Login form includes username and password fields with proper validation
Submit button calls backend admin login method
Successful login redirects to admin dashboard
Failed login displays error message without page reload
Form prevents submission with empty fields

file_operations.description: Create admin login page component with username and password input fields, form validation (required fields, min lengths), submit button that calls backend admin authentication, error message display for failed attempts, and redirect to /admin on successful login. Use shadcn/ui form components (Input, Button, Card) for consistent styling with the rest of the admin interface.

requirements.summary: Implement frontend admin session management using React Context
acceptanceCriteria: Admin authentication state persists across page refreshes
Session token is stored securely in browser storage
Logout clears admin session data completely
Expired sessions redirect to admin login page

file_operations.description: Create React Context provider and hook for admin authentication state management. Store admin session token and username in sessionStorage (cleared on browser close for security). Provide login function that calls backend authentication and stores returned token, logout function that clears storage and redirects to /admin/login, and isAdminAuthenticated boolean state. Include useEffect to initialize state from storage on mount and clear expired sessions.

requirements.summary: Create protected route wrapper component for admin routes
acceptanceCriteria: All admin routes require authentication before rendering
Unauthenticated access attempts redirect to admin login
Authenticated admin users can access all admin pages
Route protection works consistently across all admin paths

file_operations.description: Create wrapper component that uses useAdminAuth hook to check admin authentication status. If not authenticated, redirect to /admin/login using TanStack Router's navigate function. If authenticated, render children components. Include loading state while checking authentication to prevent flash of unauthorized content.

Wrap all existing admin routes (AdminPanel, AdminThemeSettings, AdminPageManagement, AdminPricingSettings, AdminPaymentGateways, AdminPayments, AdminPropFirms, AdminOffers, AdminReviews, AdminDisputes, AdminProducts, AdminUsers, AdminSubscriptions, AdminAffiliateWithdrawals) with AdminProtectedRoute component to require authentication before access. Import AdminProtectedRoute and wrap each admin route's component property.

requirements.summary: Update AdminPanel.tsx to display admin profile and logout functionality
acceptanceCriteria: Admin dashboard header shows current admin username
Logout button is visible and accessible in admin panel
Clicking logout clears session and returns to login page
Admin role is displayed if multiple admin types exist

file_operations.description: Add header section at the top of AdminPanel displaying logged-in admin username and role (retrieved from useAdminAuth hook). Include logout button in the header that calls the logout function from useAdminAuth context. Style header with flex layout to align username on left and logout button on right. Use existing card styling for consistency with the rest of the admin panel.

requirements.summary: Add admin login route to App.tsx routing configuration
acceptanceCriteria: Route /admin/login renders AdminLogin component
Admin login page is accessible without authentication
Route does not conflict with existing admin routes
Successful login redirects to /admin path

file_operations.description: Add new route configuration for /admin/login path that renders AdminLogin component. Place this route before the protected admin routes to ensure it's accessible without authentication. Import AdminLogin component at the top of the file. Ensure the route is configured with TanStack Router's Route component.

Wrap the App component with AdminAuthProvider (from useAdminAuth.tsx) to provide admin authentication context throughout the application. Place it inside the existing InternetIdentityProvider but outside QueryClientProvider to ensure admin auth state is available globally. Import AdminAuthProvider and add it to the component tree.
